People Ops: Heads-up  SF office will close early (4pm) on Friday 7/18 for scheduled electrical testing. Please see notes below for travel, desk, and accessibility.

Liam: Will shuttle pickups change for folks staying nearby?
Travel Bot: Weve added a 3:30pm shuttle run and kept the usual 6:30pm. Please book via the travel portal.
Aisha: Im flying out Friday night  is hotel coverage available?
People Ops: If testing impacts your commute, you may request one nights hotel up to $150 (Expensify tag "electrical-2026"). Ask your manager for approval.
Facilities Bot: Badge access: turnstiles will close at 3:45pm; security will escort badge-holders leaving after 4pm. Bring ID.
People Ops: Desk reservations: if you had a desk after 4pm it will be auto-cancelled and refunded. If you need guaranteed space earlier, DM us and well reserve a 1/2-day desk.
Rosa (Facilities): Accessibility note: weve arranged staff escorts for anyone needing step-free exits during the testing window. DM for details.
Liam: Thanks  I'll move my 5pm sync to earlier and book the 3:30 shuttle.
People Ops: Thanks all  final reminder email + calendar update will go out tomorrow morning.
